evaluation: unseen users; complete histories, chunked at 128 reviews; no gradient updates or fitting on held-out users
holdout: 20% disjoint user holdout; mask labels pointing outside the retained full history

training.initialization: fresh seed-paired weights and AdamW; no checkpoint reuse

budget: Explicit human count: iteration 8 of 10; complete the count despite consecutive misses; reuse accepted references; fixed cohort; no broader validation

acceptance.metrics: Curve/Instant binary logloss, label-weighted and user-averaged, each separately
acceptance.parity: compare update metadata/loss/norm, initial/final weight hashes and held-out input hashes; exact final weights and scores preferred
acceptance.quality_gate: measured relative loss regression <=0.1% (round ceiling); confidence intervals reported separately; original baseline <=2% preferred
acceptance.status: preliminary only; 20 distinct evaluation users do not satisfy the 500-evaluation-user validation gate
acceptance.comparisons: measured regression vs previous accepted run <=0.1% (round ceiling); original baseline <=2% preferred; uncertainty reported separately

expertium.rule: median over all pairs of complete full-history repeats with identical cohort, training settings, options, config and trained weights of max/min - 1 reviews/s (human decision 2026-10-12; replaces the widest group's max/min)

timing: raw review presentations/s uses complete training including loads, preparation/worker startup+shutdown, transfers, updates and logs; setup/primer/save/evaluation/process wall recorded separately

expertium.E72-F71-F73a: F73a stacks five preparation workers on F71 core placement: each worker keeps its own physical core and the main process gets three dedicated cores instead of two. E72 aliases the accepted 0072 options for Windows path length. Batch bytes and RNG are identical across 6/5/4 workers.
expertium.E76-F86-F65c: Stacks the two exact stack candidates on accepted 0076 (E76): F86 power-throttling opt-out at above-normal priority for the main process and pinned workers, and F65c native GroupNorm dispatcher/autograd with unchanged reduction kernels. E76 aliases the accepted 0076 options for Windows path length.

check_policy: reuse applicable profiles; focused smoke checks for changed code, no mandatory paired repeats
